import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

class GateFixture(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_independent_approval_at_exact_base(self):
        self.assertTrue(Path("scripts/check-java-submission.py").is_file(), "The base does not run an independent Java approval check")
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-X", "utf8", "-m", "unittest", "discover",
                                 "-s", "scripts/tests", "-p", "test_java_submission.py"],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=130)
        self.assertEqual(0, result.returncode, result.stdout + result.stderr)

suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(GateFixture)
names = [test.id() for test in suite]
result = unittest.TextTestRunner().run(suite)
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps({
    "runId": sys.argv[2], "tests": result.testsRun, "failures": len(result.failures), "errors": len(result.errors),
    "skipped": len(result.skipped), "names": names, "failedNames": [test.id() for test, _ in result.failures],
}), encoding="utf-8")
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

class RuntimeContract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_actual_module_and_spring_contracts(self):
        self.assertTrue(Path("scripts/java-contract/build.gradle").is_file(), "The base has no contract verifier to run")
        gradle = shutil.which("gradle")
        self.assertIsNotNone(gradle, "Gradle must be installed to replay contract verification")
        command = [gradle, "--no-daemon", "-p", "scripts/java-contract", "test"]
        if os.name == "nt" and gradle.lower().endswith((".bat", ".cmd")):
            command = ["cmd.exe", "/d", "/c", *command]
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=140)
        self.assertEqual(0, result.returncode, result.stdout + result.stderr)

    def test_workflow_runs_independent_and_runtime_checks(self):
        workflow = Path(".github/workflows/java-contract.yml")
        self.assertTrue(workflow.is_file(), "The base has no submitted Java contract workflow")
        source = workflow.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for text in ("check-java-submission.py", "exportLumiaContractInputs", "moduleContract", "httpContract", "CONTRACT_PR_HEAD"):
            self.assertIn(text, source)
        self.assertIn('git archive "$CONTRACT_BASE"', source)

suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(RuntimeContract)
names = [test.id() for test in suite]
result = unittest.TextTestRunner().run(suite)
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps({
    "runId": sys.argv[2], "tests": result.testsRun, "failures": len(result.failures), "errors": len(result.errors),
    "skipped": len(result.skipped), "names": names, "failedNames": [test.id() for test, _ in result.failures],
}), encoding="utf-8")
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
